question: Can pre-outcome trade-network stress states predict the subsequent adaptation family—stable replacement, diversification, fragmentation, or failure-to-adapt—without requiring one exact partner identity?
hypothesis: A multi-dimensional trade-network stress state contains predictive information about the family of adaptation that follows, beyond fit-only target-history and state-persistence baselines.
causal_scope: No causal claim; observed trade-network stress is endogenous.

universe.reporters: 135 reporters with fixed ten-partner pools from IMF IMTS V2
universe.partial_coverage_policy: No imputation; states require at least five observed positive candidates and retain observed_count.

state.flow_stress: total_t <= 0.70 times minimum valid total at t-1,t-2
state.top1_exit: top1 identity changes from t-1 to t

event.definition: t is an event when t-2,t-1,t are valid, t-1 has at least five observed candidates, and t-1 is high-concentration OR t has flow_stress OR concentration_stress OR top1_exit.
event.pre_event_information: Only t-2,t-1,t states; outcomes start at t+1.
event.overlap: First qualifying event per reporter, then no second event within two years.

path.candidate: At event time, predict stable_replacement if top1_exit and event top1 share >=0.40; predict diversification if concentration_stress; predict fragmentation if flow_stress without top1_exit; otherwise failure_to_adapt.

outcomes.stable_replacement: At t+h, top1 identity differs from pre-event top1 and top1 share >0.40.
outcomes.diversification: At t+h, top1 share is at least 0.10 below pre-event top1 share and remains >0.50.
outcomes.fragmentation: At t+h, top1 share <=0.50 and stable_replacement is false.
outcomes.failure_to_adapt: All required future states are valid and preceding families do not apply.
outcomes.unclassifiable: Required future state missing; no imputation.

evaluation.evaluation: event years in origin+1 through origin+2 with outcome horizon available
baselines: pre_state transition conditional on pre-event concentration bucket and top1_exit

null_controls.purpose: distinguish path from local temporal continuity

multiple_testing.primary_family: candidate advantage versus three baselines at h=2

admission.coverage: at least 30 eligible final h=2 events
admission.effect: candidate Brier at least 0.05 lower than best baseline and candidate family accuracy at least 0.05 higher
admission.rolling: non-negative Brier improvement at all origins and >=0.02 at three origins
admission.nulls: all non-degenerate and primary advantage passes Holm
admission.concentration: no reporter >5% of final events and direction survives top-three reporter exclusion
